subject: Renewal closeout: final true‑up invoice & payment plan coordination
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@craftlytics.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Final true‑up & end‑of‑term invoice (PO attached)

Hi Neha,

We’re approaching the end of our 12‑month term on Dec 1. Procurement asked me to request the final true‑up invoice so they can process payment against PO CL‑9921 prior to month end. Two asks from AP:

- Final invoice showing subscription, overage/true‑up lines, and any credits applied.
- Clear tax breakdown (sales tax / VAT line items) and the remit instructions (wire / ACH).

I’ve attached the PO (PO‑CL‑9921.pdf). Can you confirm whether the pre‑paid credits from our Q3 comms are being applied to the final invoice? If we can get the final PDF and a line‑item CSV today or tomorrow, I’ll flag to AP for a Dec 1 payment run.

Thanks — Elena
Elena Morales
Head of Finance Ops, CraftLytics
accounts-payable@craftlytics.com

Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Final true‑up & end‑of‑term invoice (PO attached)

Elena — thanks for the PO and the heads up. We can do that. Quick notes:

- We will produce a single final invoice that includes: subscription renewal charge, usage true‑up (overage), and the credit line for Q3 pre‑paid credit of $12,750.
- Sales tax: Redwood will break out state sales tax where applicable. If CraftLytics has an EU entity that’s the billed party, please confirm VAT treatment (reverse charge) — otherwise we’ll include US state tax lines.
- Payment options: wire and ACH; I’ll include wire instructions on the invoice PDF.

I’m attaching a draft line‑item spreadsheet for your AP team to review (draft‑invoice‑lineitems.xlsx). Kar­t­hik is copied to confirm whether we should net the credit now or show it as a credit memo applied at payment. If you need the invoice split into two installments for internal cash‑flow, let us know the schedule and we can issue a pro‑forma and a final.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

Neha / Elena — quick procurement note from our side:

- If CraftLytics will pay against PO‑CL‑9921, we should apply the $12,750 credit as a line item (negative amount) on the final invoice rather than issuing a separate credit memo — that avoids extra AR steps on their side.
- For tax: if the invoice will be billed to CraftLytics EU (DE) entity, we need their VAT ID to apply reverse‑charge. If billed to the US entity, we apply state sales tax where required.
- For speed, I’m OK with a split payment schedule if Elena’s AP needs it. Suggested schedule: 60% net 30 (due 12/30) and 40% net 45 (due 01/15). If AP prefers 50/50 across Dec/Jan we can accommodate.

Marissa — can you confirm the final invoice PDF + W‑9 and the DocuSign amendment for the seat change? We need those attached for CraftLytics AP.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Commercial Ops
